'''Ruggers''' were fluffy herbivorous rodents native to the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and were considered cute to many [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They lived in the planetoid's grassy plains (yellow-furred) or high in the trees (greenish white-furred), eating nuts and berries, and hibernating in the cold winter seasons. Among their adaptations, they had sharp, strong incisors for nut-cracking and suction-like foot pads for stability and grasping. Ruggers of both species were common favored prey of [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] and [[Temptor/Legends|temptors]].

Domestic ruggers were kept as pets by the wealthy on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and had white fur.
